A cover that holds its shape
The hard PU cover keeps corners sharp even after months in a bag, so it still looks new at the next onboarding session or sprint planning.
Foil or deboss, not a sticker
Your logo goes on via foil stamp or deboss directly into the cover, which reads as considerably more premium than a printed label and won't peel.
96 pages of actual lined paper
Enough room for a full onboarding period or a quarter's worth of meeting notes, on paper that takes ink well without bleeding through.
Details that keep it closed
An elastic band keeps it shut in a bag, a ribbon marks the current page, and a back pocket holds loose business cards or a folded handout.
